notes: «أبو معن الرقاشي، زيد بن يزيد الثقفي» is kunya, nisba, comma, name with no «و» between: one man, as in worked example 4
«- بصري ثقة -» is an editor gloss between dashes, left out
«بمثل حديث يحيى القطان» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, never a route
